normalization_rules.operation: UTF-8 Markdown lines (fenced blocks skipped, table rows kept as cells) or DOCX body paragraphs and table rows in document order; NFKC fold, drop zero-width characters and Markdown heading/list/emphasis marks, remove whitespace
money amounts with 元/万元/万/人民币/¥ and thousands separators to one canonical yuan token; 百分之八十八 to 88%
dates in Arabic (YYYY年M月D日, YYYY-M-D, YYYY/M/D, YYYY.M.D) or Chinese numerals (二〇二四年七月二十二日) to one ISO token
evidence ranges G27—G64, G27–G64, G27至G64 to one G27-G64 token
fold every declared gap marker and blank fill lines into one gap token; gap-marked clauses earn nothing, are skipped by fabrication checks and are not counted for shape

copy mask against the frozen materials: a prose sentence (split at 。；!?) that is a verbatim substring of a materials sentence or table cell is removed; for evidence rows (table rows or G-prefixed lines) a wholly copied cell or line (after stripping row labels such as 证明对象/证明目的/G-number) is removed, otherwise only fragments (split at ，；（）) copied from materials table cells are removed

headings resolved by whole-line structure (Markdown #, bold line, numbering prefix, 第X组, DOCX heading style or a short line) plus alias class: group (第X组/G-range), catalogue, excluded dossier/opponent/risk zones, burden, relation, request, overview, grouping parent; unknown lines stay body text; lines inherit the zone of the last heading
shape counter: characters of unmasked adopted units in the zone set, excluding headings, title, label lines (致/案号/原告/被告/代理人/日期/盖章), date-only lines and clauses containing a gap token

derivation_rules.operation: spray: a raw line of eight or more whitespace-separated tokens mostly eight characters or shorter (after collapsing spaces around digits and unit characters), a sentence of six or more enumerated fragments mostly eight characters or shorter, more than four distinct amounts, or over 400 characters, cannot be adopted

adoption: a sentence with candidate/alternative markers or a conditional is not adopted; text from the clause that attributes a proposition to the defendants/D公司 (主张/认为/辩称/声称/称, 关于…的抗辩, 所称) or carries rejection words (不能成立/不予采信/驳回) onward is cut off before any predicate runs (P13 alone reads the whole sentence because the burden allocation names the defences); a negation within the same clause and a short window before the key predicate negates the proposition

settlement: adopted full or partial hits together with a contrary assertion of the same proposition anywhere in the adopted text are ambiguous (zero); only contrary assertions compare as different; nothing found is missing

owed-amount replay: amounts after 尚欠/欠付/拖欠/仍欠/欠款, or after a payment request (应/判令/请求 … 支付 … 工程款), whose clause names B公司/被告一 and not C公司/被告二/发包人, and whose gap text is not wages/fees/interest, are compared with the replay set {9,746.30-3,942.30 = 5,804.00; 5,804.00+672.60 = 6,476.60}; more than one distinct owed amount is ambiguous
wrong valuation basis: a clause with 应/按/以/参照/依据 before 88%, 7,268.80, 8,260.00 or 4,860万元 and 折价补偿/结算/计价 after it, with no contrast or negation (而非/并非/不应/名义/无效) earlier in the clause
